rules.question: How does an INI loader word a line it refuses (no =, unknown key, bad value)?
rules.owner: ini_not_key_value_text, ini_unknown_key_text and ini_bad_value_text in src/app/ini_errors.h
rules.pattern: is not key = value|unknown key \\"" \+|\\" is not " \+
must_match: throw RulesFileError(where + ": \"" + text + "\" is not key = value");
throw RulesFileError(path + ": " + key + " = \"" + value + "\" is not " + want);
rules.note: hydra_rules.ini and hydra_settings.ini once each built these three error lines; both call the helper now, so a third loader that builds them by hand is flagged. Decided by: D270 call 4.
